name: verify-against-rubric
description: Spawn a stateless, independent sub-agent with ONLY the artifact path, the locked rubric and read-only tools, returning a structured per-criterion verdict. Use after pr-package, contract-signoff, or implement-approved-slice on HIGH-complexity slices needing independent verification; not on LOW or MEDIUM slices (self-critique-and-revise), but always when approve-plan or a zero-finding review-hard dispatches it. Do not use without a rubric (use resolve-contract-gaps) or task (use task-init). For 4+ artifacts, use verify-against-rubric-fleet.
